missions.title: Showing the Flag
missions.briefing: Osei, diplomatic corps. Earth's telescopes picked up something here nobody can explain: radio, perhaps, or city lights. Run a long-range scan, then take the Meridian to the world that shows signs of a civilization.

objectives.hint: Select the ship on the SYSTEM display and press SCAN.

message.text: There: {world}. Regular patterns on the night side, and something on the radio bands. Take us there, gently.

missions.debrief: In orbit of {world}, and they are real: towns, roads, fields. We are the first humans to see them.

missions.title: The Probe That Talks
missions.briefing: Osei. Something has been shadowing us since we reached {world}: a small probe, not ours, sending the same pattern over and over. Let it come to us, decode the pattern, then answer it. If it is theirs, our answer is the first thing they will ever hear from us.

objectives.hint: It follows the ship: hold still and it comes to you, then SCAN it.
Set course for the probe, hold there and DECODE THE PATTERN (Science crew; the work is kept if you leave).
ANSWER IT: three choices, a minute each (the first is taken when time runs out). Stay with the probe until the answer is sent.
Understood, our first contact with its makers will go easier.

missions.debrief: The probe has gone home with our answer. If {world} built it, they have heard from us before they have seen us.

missions.title: Listening Post
missions.briefing: Before we say a word to them we have to understand them. Put a hidden observation post on {world}: small, quiet, out of sight.

objectives.hint: In orbit of {world}, once the sensor sweep is done: OBSERVATION POST on its card.

missions.debrief: The post is down and listening. Language, music, arguments in the market square: it's all coming in.

missions.title: Study
missions.briefing: Now we listen. Stay in orbit of {world} and fill the dossier: who they are, how they live, how far along they are.

objectives.hint: The ship's sensors study them while it is in orbit (or a satellite does).

missions.debrief: The dossier is full. We know who they are now, and we know what we would be walking into.

missions.title: First Words
missions.briefing: This is what the Meridian was built for. There is no Prime Directive yet, only our judgement. Make first contact with {world}, and choose how: who goes, what we offer, what we share.

objectives.hint: In orbit of {world}: FIRST CONTACT on its card, then make the three choices. Leaving orbit calls it off.

missions.debrief: First words spoken. Whatever comes of it, the people of {world} know now that they are not alone.

missions.title: Their Lost Ship
missions.briefing: Osei. Now that they know us, the people of {world} have asked for help: one of their ships, {lost}, has been adrift since before we came. Her reactor is cold and her crew long gone. We can tow her home, which they would never forget, or study her first, which the science team is begging for, and which they may not take kindly to.

objectives.hint: Set course for her ({lost.distance} s) and COME ALONGSIDE: her reactor is cold, there is no clock.

stages.title: Tow her home, or study her

choices.text: Study her first (they may call it an incident)

objectives.hint: TAKE IN TOW from alongside (come alongside again if you left her).
Set course for {world} with her in tow.

message.text: Osei: Their crews are coming up for her. Hold orbit while they take her: they have never had anyone bring one of theirs home before.

objectives.text: Hold orbit at {world} while their crews take her

objectives.hint: RESTORE POWER (Engineering work, or a patch kit at once). Come alongside again first if you left her.
RECOVER LOGS once she has power.

message.text: Osei: The science team has her logs. Now we tell {world} what we did, and hope they see it our way.

objectives.text: Hold position at {lost} while the data is copied
objectives.hint: Stay with her a little longer.

missions.debrief: Whatever we chose, {world} will remember how we treated one of theirs. Osei is writing it all down for Earth.

missions.title: Guests Aboard
missions.briefing: They have accepted our invitation: a delegation is coming up to the Meridian. Hold orbit of {world} while they are aboard.

objectives.hint: Stay in orbit while the delegation tours the ship.

missions.debrief: The delegation has gone home with gifts, recordings and a standing invitation to Earth. Osei out: that's the chapter, Meridian, and a fine one.
